# New Zealand

Region: Oceania. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Reserve Bank of New Zealand / Payments NZ

**Role:** ESAS RTGS operator / HVCS scheme body

**Reporting coverage:** ESAS account statements and request messages supported; exact CAMT namespace not publicly established in reviewed overview

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 statements/requests; exact reporting message numbers not evidenced

- [ESAS andfinancialsystem](https://www.rbnz.govt.nz/payments-and-settlement-systems/exchange-settlements-account-system/esas-and-the-financial-system) — availability; public-page
- [PaymentsNZ ISO 20022 project perspective](https://www.paymentsnz.co.nz/resources/articles/iso-20022-a-project-perspective/) — availability; public-page

RBNZ states that ESAS version 7 added statement and request messages in July 2025, completing ISO compliance; MT and MX statement/enquiry coexistence continues after November 2025. Payments NZ HVCS aligns closely with CBPR+ while adding local requirements. Exact corporate reporting versions were not established.
